task.description:
Write specs and integration tests for ISS-401..404.

tests/specs/ISS-401.md + tests/integration/iss401_rate_limiter_test.zig:
- TC1: requests under limit pass through; TC2: exceeding limit returns 429; TC3: Retry-After header present; TC4: different tenants/principals have separate limits; TC5: sliding window resets after window passes

tests/specs/ISS-402.md + tests/integration/iss402_oidc_cache_test.zig:
- TC1: valid OIDC token cached and honoured; TC2: token expiry bounds cache TTL; TC3: revoked jti rejected before exp; TC4: realm logout adds all active jti to denylist

tests/specs/ISS-403.md + tests/integration/iss403_oidc_rate_key_test.zig:
- TC1: OIDC principal rate-limited independently of local tokens; TC2: rate-limit key contains (tenant_id, realm, sub)

tests/specs/ISS-404.md + tests/integration/iss404_token_role_snapshot_test.zig:
- TC1: issued token roles match user_roles at issuance time; TC2: changing user_roles after issuance does not alter token roles; TC3: re-issuing token picks up new roles

All: real PostgreSQL, per-test UUIDs, no mocks, no Error.SkipZigTest.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 spec files cover listed test cases
